name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Here are the military officials who've been fired or resigned under Hegseth
changes.summary: At least 20 generals, admirals and civilian defense leaders have been fired or have departed their jobs since Pete Hegseth became defense secretary at the beginning of the second Trump administration.

changes.title: Trump to Nominate Hung Cao as Navy Secretary
changes.summary: The announcement came amid a purge of leadership at the Pentagon and a stalling war effort against Iran.

changes.title: U.S. military strikes Iran, while Trump vows more for Tehran's retaliation
changes.summary: The U.S. military hit targets in Iran on Tuesday and Tehran fired missiles and drones at various sites across the region in response as hostilities flare once again in an intermittent war. (Image credit: Amirhosein Khorgooi).

changes.title: China or the U.S.? Two Meetings Offer Competing Showcases of Global Power.
changes.summary: As Xi Jinping gathered with the leaders of Russia and Iran, Europe challenged the Trump administration at the G20, offering a split-screen view of a changing world.

changes.title: How the Pentagon Is Getting Into the Venezuelan Oil Business Under Trump
changes.summary: The Defense Department’s Office of Strategic Capital, founded by the Biden administration to give loans to bolster the U.S. defense industry, is helping lead President Trump’s oil deal.

changes.title: Whistle-Blower Says USPS Is Secretly Proceeding on Trump’s Mail Voting Plan Before Midterms
changes.summary: A report detailed “grave concerns” that a new system being rushed into use by the U.S. Postal Service could imperil millions of mail ballots ahead of the midterm elections.

changes.title: Trump says Venezuelan oil could replenish depleted U.S. stockpiles. Will it?
changes.summary: President Trump framed last week's deal for the U.S. government to take a stake in Venezuelan oil as a boon for the depleted Strategic Petroleum Reserve. But the plan faces some hurdles, experts say.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: The legislation, which already passed the Senate, now goes to President Donald Trump to become law, checking off the main item on Congress’ to-do list ahead of the midterms.

changes.title: ICE says it has enough body cameras now, after series of deadly shootings
changes.summary: Cameras could help alleviate some concerns about ICE transparency and accountability after immigration officers were involved in over two dozen shootings under the Trump administration. (Image credit: Michael M. Santiago).

changes.title: Trump's pro-data center stance is putting pressure on Republicans ahead of midterms
changes.summary: Trump's pro-data center stance is out of step with voters. Republicans are trying to navigate the issue but it's putting them at odds with the president's AI agenda.
